_comment: Recipient routing rules for Caribbean Opportunity Dispatch.

diaspora_investor.label: Diaspora Investor
diaspora_investor.description: Caribbean diaspora capital networks — want validated, high-confidence entry points with clear next steps for capital deployment

founder_operator.label: Regional Founder/Operator
founder_operator.description: Entrepreneurs and operators active in Caribbean markets — want sector-specific signals and procurement/partnership leads

ecosystem_builder.label: Ecosystem Builder
ecosystem_builder.description: Accelerators, trade agencies, chambers — want regional trend awareness and cross-country opportunity maps

regional_operator.label: Regional Operator
regional_operator.description: On-the-ground operators in logistics, tourism, infrastructure — want operational signals and procurement notices

procurement_watcher.label: Procurement Watcher
procurement_watcher.description: Entities tracking CDB/IDB procurement — want project pipeline detail and opportunity-specific notifications

operator_resilience.label: Operations/Resilience
operator_resilience.description: Operations and logistics teams — want marine/storm alerts with immediate action windows

tourism_logistics_operator.label: Tourism/Logistics Operator
tourism_logistics_operator.description: Tourism boards, hotel operators, shipping — want demand signals and hazard context

policy_media.label: Policy/Media
policy_media.description: Policy analysts, journalists, regional media — want cross-country context and vulnerability awareness

enhanced_investment.decision_to_influence: Which verified opportunity to investigate for capital deployment or partnership entry

routing_rationale.diaspora_investor: Multi-source validation reduces screening risk — capital follows verified signals
routing_rationale.ecosystem_builder: Cross-country investment velocity signals where to focus ecosystem support and founder matching
routing_rationale.founder_operator: Multi-source investment lift indicates growing market that may support new entry or expansion

investment_signal.decision_to_influence: Which country-sector pair to validate for investment readiness

routing_rationale.diaspora_investor: Single-source FDI movement is a screening trigger, not a deployment signal — start diligence
routing_rationale.founder_operator: FDI movement in your operating country signals competition or demand growth — assess positioning

development_pipeline.decision_to_influence: Which procurement or project opportunity to pursue

routing_rationale.regional_operator: Active procurement directly maps to operational capacity needs — first to respond wins
routing_rationale.procurement_watcher: CDB/IDB project pipeline is the primary lead source for project-based business development
routing_rationale.founder_operator: Procurement pipeline signals government and institutional spending direction — follow the money

economic_vulnerability.decision_to_influence: Risk assessment for capital exposure or policy attention

routing_rationale.diaspora_investor: Vulnerability signals change risk profiles — reassess exposure and timing
routing_rationale.policy_media: Economic stress indicators drive policy response and media narratives

food_security.decision_to_influence: Agricultural/logistics investment case or policy response planning

routing_rationale.ecosystem_builder: Food trade data reveals supply chain gaps that local founders and agri-tech can fill
routing_rationale.policy_media: Food security is a regional stability indicator — tracks pressure points before they become crises

tourism_impact.decision_to_influence: Tourism capacity planning and timing of marketing or expansion

routing_rationale.tourism_logistics_operator: GDP growth in tourism-relevant economies signals demand trajectory — plan capacity accordingly
routing_rationale.founder_operator: Tourism-linked GDP growth in your operating country indicates broader consumer demand

routing_rationale.operator_resilience: Buoy pressure + marine alert convergence = elevated confidence for operational response trigger
routing_rationale.tourism_logistics_operator: Cyclone risk directly impacts tourism bookings and logistics routing — advance warning for contingency

routing_rationale.operator_resilience: Named storm with track data is a time-critical operational event — response windows measured in hours
Pre-storm development monitoring allows staged preparedness without response fatigue

maritime_hazard.decision_to_influence: Maritime operations adjustment for safety and logistics routing

routing_rationale.operator_resilience: High-wind + marine alert confirmation requires safety response and shipping route adjustments
routing_rationale.tourism_logistics_operator: Maritime hazards affect island supply chains and tourism transport schedules
